text:
Sam: Heads up — after the egress tighten in us-west-2 (terraform) we saw ~30% provisioning failures for the GPU warm pool in staging. Keystore decrypts started returning 403 for new ENIs.
Marta: which rule was applied? fw-team or infra change?
Sam: fw-egress-privnet (sg-0a1b2c3d) pushed in PR #2348. Alert links: https://console.ops/redwood/alerts/4955
Alex: checked logs — keystore-proxy shows "AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to decrypt" when called from ENI IPs in 10.100.0.0/16. Flow logs missing on the subnet so we couldn't trace the NAT path.
Priya: hmm. That would block KMS decrypts used for node bootstrap, so nodes fail to pull model keys and provisioning aborts.
Marta: please paste the minimal failing curl/response
Alex: 
```
curl -sv https://keystore.internal.redwood/v1/decrypt -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." 
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< x-amz-err: AccessDenied
```
Sam: mitigation we rolled: 1) revert security group rule in staging 2) add temporary KMS policy allowing decrypt from role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/privnet-node 3) drain affected warm pool nodes and scale a clean pool up
Priya: cost hit — we held ~50 GPUs idle for ~2h while draining/repaving. Approx cost impact ~$1.2k (staging rates). Logging/alerts in billing.
Marta: audit-bot shows flow logs were disabled for subnet subnet-0cde. Can we enable immediately and add an alert if flow logs drop? We also need a runbook entry for KMS deny symptoms.
audit-bot: Flow logs status changed for subnet-0cde: DISABLED -> ENABLED by Priya at 2026-03-20T15:22Z
Alex: followups: - add test in provisioning CI to simulate KMS deny and fallback - add a WG to review default egress deny PRs with infra/security signoff
Priya: I'll open infra ticket and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow. For now thumbs up. :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks — keeping an eye. will post postmortem link when I have it.
